protocol.hypothesis: One known 5m ATR must cover at least twice estimated flat-price round-trip fees/slippage/ticks before accepting an archived G91 signal.
protocol.thresholdSelection: Fixed design choice before this run, not fitted or chosen from a threshold search. One ATR is a recent range measure, NOT a forecast or guaranteed gain.
protocol.fixed: Same original 5m decisions, 1m execution, automatic25/50/25 ladder at net10/20/40% of original margin, lock0.25R when eligible, stops/limits/funding,1% risk,10x/15x source leverage and fixed5BRL/USDT. No holding-time cap, no new training.
protocol.gateInformation: Only last CLOSED feature known at signal time: close, ATR, side, frozen fee/slippage/tick. Estimate entry and exit at that close with adverse tick rounding and both fees. No future fill, future return, source net PNL, max favorable excursion or group outcome. Unknown future funding excluded from estimate but actual funding remains charged in simulation.
protocol.calendars: All320 frozen source signals in15 already-consumed months; ten train months and five development months shown separately. No2025 orSeptember2026 data opened. G91 itself was trained/selected using these histories, so neither split is independent validation.
protocol.wallets: Each arm has one independent continuous R$1000 wallet per source month. Own cash sizing; monthly loss state never restarted inside a month. Rejected signals leave cash idle. Keep zero-trade months in averages and CDI comparisons. Do not compound monthly restarts. Source signal schedule fixed: missing candidates after a declined entry are not regenerated; not a complete new entry policy.
protocol.primary: Report five paired development monthly PNL differences cost_gate minus control, mean, median, losing months, above-CDI months, actual trades, filter/overlap/risk skips. Show all ten train months separately. All positions/costs after filtering use each arm own capital.
protocol.decision: Failure of any criterion: do not advance. Passing only supports registering a NEW prospective paper period after freeze, never profitability proof or automatic promotion. No threshold revision after results in this run. Small/zero accepted sample is a valid result.
protocol.prospective: Not started or consumed. No untouched historical calendar claimed. Any future independent paper experiment requires its own timestamped protocol after freezing the candidate.
